Announcer.Intro01: [b][Announcer][/b] Thank you for participating in Test Course B.
Announcer.Intro02: [b][Announcer][/b] You have been assigned test subject ID #4-0-8-0
Announcer.Intro03: [b][Announcer][/b] This testing course may be very dangerous.
Announcer.Intro04: [b][Announcer][/b] This course contains the following hazards:
Announcer.Intro12: [b][Announcer][/b] If you are okay with all of these, do not speak now.
Announcer.Intro13: [b][Announcer][/b] To make sure your copy of [HUMANITY] was installed correctly,
Announcer.Intro14: [b][Announcer][/b] we will be running a very simple physical and mental health exercise.
Announcer.Chamber1.01: [b][Announcer][/b] This test has been designed to verify you can move and think properly.
Announcer.Chamber1.02: [b][Announcer][/b] Please go and place the cube onto the button.
Announcer.Chamber1.Complete: [b][Announcer][/b] Good. You have proven that you are smarter than a mouse. Proceed to the teleporter.
Announcer.Chamber1.BoxTrap: [b][Announcer][/b] You have managed to permanently trap yourself within this room. Good job. A new box has been deployed.
Announcer.Chamber1.WallClip: [b][Announcer][/b] An attempt to leave the game's playable area has been detected. We have prevented this attempt to make sure you have the most optimal gaming experience possible. Thank you and have fun!
Announcer.Chamber4.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Hold on. You're completeting these tests faster than our level designers can finish building them,
Announcer.Chamber4.02: [b][Announcer][/b] So just give me a few more moments while I put the last few finishing touches on this next test.
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Test subject! I'm so sorry! It seems we've experienced some issues in getting you to your next test chamber!
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.02: [b][Announcer][/b] Apparently, the level designer can't come up with an idea for this chamber and they're just smacking things together at random!
Announcer.OLD.Chamber5.03: [b][Announcer][/b] Although, with the state it's in, I doubt that entry door will open any time soon. Luckily, that tube in front of you broke that wall clean open.
Announcer.Chapter1Demo: [b][Announcer][/b] Good job on completing the Chapter 1 playtest and [s]Chapter 2 demo[/s]. Your feedback would be greatly appreciated as this project is still a severe work in progress.
Announcer.Chamber3.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Did you know that 98% of test subjects experience disorientation after emerging from stasis?
Announcer.Chamber3.02: [b][Announcer][/b] It doesn't seem you're in that 98% though, as you completed one of our most mechanically complex tests in record pace.
Announcer.Chamber2.Intro: [b][Announcer][/b] Welcome to the first [i]real[/i] test. Good luck.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Ve- ve- very good! You are now in possession of the Masonry Toolkit Generic Quantum Manipulator.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.02: [b][Announcer][/b] With it, you can create two linked bridges in space! In layman's terms, it lets you make portals.
Announcer.Chamber1.GetPortalGun.03: [b][Announcer][/b] However, it seems this part of the testing course isn't in the best shape. I am going to open a panel for you.
Announcer.Chamber1.Part2Intro: [b][Announcer][/b] This next test was designed for users that only had the single-tunnel device. However, you have the dual-tunnel device. I'm sure you can make due with it.
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.01: [b][Announcer][/b] Whoa! Test subject- Are you okay? I'm sorry, I didn't expect that to happen!
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.02: [b][Announcer][/b] I'll try to get the manual override on the box dropper in that room,
Announcer.Chamber1.ButtonFailure.03: [b][Announcer][/b] Until then, just- just try to find your own way to solve the puzzle!
Announcer.Chamber1.CompleteDialogInterru: [b][Announcer][/b] Test subject, that's incredibly rude! I was in the middle of my ending line!
Announcer.Chamber1.Part2CompleteDialog: [b][Announcer][/b] Good job on finding your way around, test subject! I knew you could do it.
